newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial wins three casino contracts.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial wins three casino contracts.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said Monday it received contracts to provide its GameCash services at San Felipe Casino Hollywood in Algodones, N.N.; Womacks Casino in Cripple Creek, Colo., and Blue Chip Casino in Michigan City, Ind.
San Felipe Casino Hollywood has about 500 gaming machines and is owned by the Pueblo of San Felipe Enterprise Board. Womacks Casino has about 500 gaming machines and is owned by Century Casinos Inc.

Blue Chip Casino is currently under construction and due to open during the third quarter of 1997. It is expected that upon opening the property will operate with 1,200 gaming machines and 50 table games, Game Financial said.

Game Financial provides gaming establishments, primarily casinos, with services that allow their patrons to access cash through credit card cash advances, check cashing services and automated teller machines.
